maddeler.e:
انطبعت (form VII)
# اِنْطَبَعْتُ (inṭabaʕtu) /in.tˤa.baʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# اِنْطَبَعْتَ (inṭabaʕta) /in.tˤa.baʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# اِنْطَبَعْتِ (inṭabaʕti) /in.tˤa.baʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# اِنْطَبَعَتْ (inṭabaʕat) /in.tˤa.ba.ʕat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
